name: Rythu Bharosa (Telangana)
benefits_summary: ₹15,000 per acre per year (₹7,500 per crop season) directly credited via DBT to cultivate crops, covering land-owning farmers and eligible tenant farmers.
documents_required: Bank Account linked to Aadhaar (NPCI active)
CCRC (Crop Cultivator Rights Card) for tenant farmers
where_to_apply: Rythu Vedika / Local Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) or Meeseva Portal

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefits_summary: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of eligible landholding farmer families.
documents_required: Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account with NPCI mapping
where_to_apply: PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in), Kisan e-Mitra or nearest CSC center

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - Rabi Insurance
benefits_summary: Comprehensive crop loss coverage against non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal hail, pests). Nominal premium (1.5% for Rabi food grains/oilseeds, 5% for commercial/horticulture).
documents_required: Sowing Certificate issued by Village Revenue Officer (VRO) or AEO
Dharani Record of Rights / Tenant lease agreement
Bank Account Passbook showing IFSC and branch

claim_window.window: Within 72 hours of localized crop calamity (hailstorm, inundation, post-harvest unseasonal rain)

where_to_apply: Cooperative Bank / Commercial Bank where crop loan is sanctioned, or CSC VLE, or pmfby.gov.in

name: Telangana Micro Irrigation Project (TSMIP)
benefits_summary: Subsidy on Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems: 100% subsidy for SC/ST farmers up to 5 acres; 90% subsidy for BC, Small & Marginal farmers; 80% for other farmers.
documents_required: Small / Marginal Farmer Certificate from Tahsildar / AEO
Electricity connection bill / water source proof
where_to_apply: Online on tsmip.cgg.gov.in or submit application to Area Horticulture Officer

name: MSP Procurement Operations (Paddy & Cotton 2026)
benefits_summary: Assured price procurement at Minimum Support Price: Grade 'A' Paddy at ₹2,320/quintal (plus Telangana state ₹500/quintal bonus on fine varieties), Medium Staple Cotton at ₹7,121/quintal.
documents_required: Pahani / Dharani digital registration with crop booking details
OPMS (Online Procurement Management System) token from Rythu Vedika
where_to_apply: Nearest PACS (Primary Agricultural Credit Society) or IKP / Marketing Yard Procurement Centre
